name: sbxEnclave
author: arikisonfire
description: Let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI work on their own without risking your machine: Docker Sandboxes (sbx) give each agent a microVM that sees only the folders you hand it and reaches only the hosts you allow, and stored API keys never enter it. sbxEnclave puts sbx in your bar: start a sandbox for any folder with every option at hand, see what your sandboxes run and reach, answer their network requests with one click and look up the CLI.

barWidget.description: Launch, watch and manage Docker Sandboxes (sbx)

schema.label: Refresh while the popup is closed (seconds)
Protected sandboxes (comma separated): no Stop or Remove, and the daemon is not stopped while they run
